_comment: Board game shelf data. Each game has an array of tag ids (defined in 'tags'). Length tag uses max play time: short <=30, medium 31-60, long >60. Complexity tag uses BGG weight: light <2, medium 2-2.9, heavy >=3. Player counts are numeric (playersMin/playersMax); the page filters on 'N players' by checking playersMin <= N <= playersMax. link.type is 'game' (direct BGG page) or 'search'.
